value.rationale: The motivating granular-gas source studies stationary temperature PDFs and variance but not fluctuation lifetimes. The natural temporal covariance has an unexpectedly strictly positive continuum of exponential modes with p-dependent edge, a one-power algebraic shift from deterministic cooling to stationary covariance, and a sharp amplitude equal to an experimentally motivated static susceptibility d_mu/dr. Exact all-positive-p log-convexity and two complementary reset-rate identities plus exponent recovery supply structural, testable mathematical information and identify meaningful Haff versus viscoelastic differences. These are not single-point experiments, a trivial normalization, or a recomputation of the source one-time moments. Particle-level and finite-sample limitations are explicitly stated.
